riskScore.calculatingHint: Its inputs changed; the new score is being computed.
riskScore.floor.desc: Findings on assets with no assigned owner can't be safely deprioritized, so keep them at P2 minimum. Off by default.
riskScore.floor.title: Floor unowned findings at P2
riskScore.impact.applied: Settings applied. Scores are being recomputed in the background.
riskScore.impact.description: What these settings change across the whole organization, computed exactly as the change will be applied.
riskScore.impact.forwardOnly: Applies from now on: open findings and their assets are recomputed in the background. Closed findings, past trends and reports keep their values. A deadline only ever moves earlier. You will be asked to confirm your identity.
riskScore.impact.overridesKept: {count} findings with a manual priority keep it.
riskScore.impact.recalculateQueued: {count} assets queued for a new risk score.
riskScore.impact.title: Review the impact
riskScore.model.amplifyHint: Highly-exposed critical assets no longer all pin at 100. The exposure boost fills the remaining range instead of overflowing, which improves ranking at the top. An asset without an open finding scores 0.
riskScore.model.howLikelihood: Risk = findings score × exposure factor × criticality factor × (1 − control reduction). The findings score grows with each open finding by severity, with diminishing returns; exploit signals count one severity higher.
riskScore.model.howLikelihoodZero: An asset with no open finding has a risk of 0. Exposure and criticality scale risk; they are not risk on their own.
riskScore.model.label: Score composition
riskScore.model.likelihoodImpactHint: Risk = findings score × exposure % × criticality % × (1 − control reduction).
riskScore.model.multiplyHint: Exposure multiplier scales the whole score. An asset without an open finding scores 0.
riskScore.model.notice: Risk is the findings score times the exposure and criticality factors below, lowered by compensating controls. Component weights, exposure multipliers, finding impact and CTEM points apply only to the weighted compositions; choose one under Score composition to edit them.
riskScore.name: Risk {score} of 100, {band}
riskScore.namePending: {name}. Its inputs changed; the new score is being computed.
riskScore.notScoredHint: This asset's risk score has not been computed yet.
riskScore.recalc.desc: Apply current scoring configuration to all assets. This may take a moment for large portfolios.
riskScore.recalc.title: Recalculate scores
riskScore.settings.composition.tip: Controls how the exposure multiplier combines with the weighted base score. Standard multiplies the whole score (can pin highly-exposed critical assets at 100). Amplify within headroom fills the remaining range instead, so top-risk assets keep a distinguishable ranking.
riskScore.settings.criticality.desc: Asset criticality scores and risk level threshold boundaries
riskScore.settings.criticality.scoresTip: Base score assigned to each asset based on its criticality classification. A 'Critical' asset (e.g., payment gateway) gets a higher base score than a 'Low' asset (e.g., dev blog).
riskScore.settings.criticality.tip: Criticality scores define the base risk score for each business criticality level. Risk level thresholds define the score boundaries that determine the final risk label (Critical, High, Medium, Low).
riskScore.settings.criticality.title: Criticality and risk levels
riskScore.settings.ctem.complianceTip: Bonus points for assets under high-risk compliance frameworks (PCI-DSS, SOX, etc.)
riskScore.settings.ctem.internetTip: Bonus points for assets directly reachable from the internet
riskScore.settings.ctem.off: CTEM scoring is disabled. Enable to add bonus points for threat exposure factors.
riskScore.settings.ctem.phiTip: Bonus points for assets that process or store Protected Health Information (HIPAA)
riskScore.settings.ctem.piiTip: Bonus points for assets that process or store Personally Identifiable Information
riskScore.settings.ctem.restrictedTip: Bonus points for assets that handle classified or restricted data
riskScore.settings.ctem.tip: Additional points added to the CTEM component based on specific threat exposure attributes of each asset. Points are additive (an asset with PII + internet exposure gets both bonuses).
riskScore.settings.ctem.title: CTEM bonus points
riskScore.settings.exposure.desc: Base score (0-100) for each exposure level
riskScore.settings.exposure.isolatedTip: Air-gapped or completely isolated from other networks
riskScore.settings.exposure.privateTip: Internal network only, no external access
riskScore.settings.exposure.restrictedTi: Behind VPN or firewall, limited external access
riskScore.settings.exposure.tip: Base scores assigned based on how exposed an asset is to external access. Higher scores mean more risk.
riskScore.settings.exposure.title: Exposure scores
riskScore.settings.exposure.unknownTip: Exposure level has not been classified
riskScore.settings.finding.capTip: Maximum number of findings counted toward the score. Prevents a single heavily-scanned asset from getting an unfairly high score.
riskScore.settings.finding.modeTip: Count-based: each finding adds fixed points regardless of severity. Severity-weighted: each finding adds points based on its severity level (Critical findings add more than Info findings).
riskScore.settings.finding.perFindingTip: Points added to the score for each open finding on this asset
riskScore.settings.finding.tip: Determines how vulnerability findings on an asset affect its score. Count-based adds fixed points per finding. Severity-weighted adds different points based on finding severity.
riskScore.settings.finding.title: Finding impact
riskScore.settings.finding.weightsTip: Points added per finding of each severity. E.g., if Critical=10 and an asset has 3 critical findings, it adds 30 points (capped by Finding Cap).
riskScore.settings.floor.desc: How findings on ownerless assets are prioritized
riskScore.settings.floor.heading: Unowned findings floor
riskScore.settings.floor.tip: CTEM playbook rule. When enabled, findings on assets with no assigned owner are floored at P2 priority. It is a strict floor: only ever raises a P3 to P2, never lowers anything and never touches P0/P1.
riskScore.settings.how.components: Each component produces a score (0-100) weighted by its percentage. The exposure multiplier adjusts the final score. Result is clamped to 0-100.
riskScore.settings.how.ctemOff: When CTEM is disabled, its weight is redistributed proportionally to the other components.
riskScore.settings.how.formula: Score = (Exposure x W1 + Criticality x W2 + Findings x W3 + CTEM x W4) x Multiplier
riskScore.settings.how.title: How scoring works
riskScore.settings.impact.desc: How findings and threat exposure factors affect scores
riskScore.settings.impact.tip: Configure how vulnerability findings and CTEM threat exposure factors contribute to the overall risk score.
riskScore.settings.impact.title: Finding and CTEM impact
riskScore.settings.multiplier.tip: Final score is multiplied by this factor based on asset exposure. A multiplier of 1.0 means no change, >1.0 amplifies risk, <1.0 reduces risk.
riskScore.settings.multiplier.title: Multipliers (0.1 - 3.0)
riskScore.settings.page.desc: Configure the weights and parameters that make up each asset's risk score.
riskScore.settings.page.title: Risk scoring
riskScore.settings.preset.banking.name: Banking
riskScore.settings.preset.default.name: Default
riskScore.settings.preset.ecommerce.name: E-commerce
riskScore.settings.preset.legacy.name: Legacy
riskScore.settings.presets.desc: Start from a preset optimized for your industry
riskScore.settings.presets.title: Presets
riskScore.settings.thresholds.order: Must be ordered: Critical > High > Medium > Low > 0
riskScore.settings.thresholds.tip: Minimum score required for each risk level. E.g., if Critical=80, any asset with score >= 80 is labeled Critical. Must be in descending order.
riskScore.settings.thresholds.title: Risk level thresholds (min score)
riskScore.settings.weight.criticalityTip: How much the asset's business criticality level affects its risk score
riskScore.settings.weight.ctemTip: Continuous Threat Exposure Management bonus points for factors like PII exposure, internet accessibility, and compliance risk
riskScore.settings.weight.exposureTip: How much the asset's network exposure (public, private, isolated) affects its risk score
riskScore.settings.weight.findingsTip: How much vulnerability findings (count or severity-weighted) affect the risk score
riskScore.settings.weights.ctemOff: CTEM is disabled. Its weight will be redistributed to other components.
riskScore.settings.weights.desc: Adjust the weight of each factor. Weights auto-balance to 100%.
riskScore.settings.weights.title: Component weights
riskScore.why.howItWorks: The worst severity sets the findings score; more findings of the same severity add less each time. Known-exploited findings count one severity higher.
riskScore.why.noFindings: No open findings: nothing adds risk to this asset.
riskScore.why.pending: A rescore is queued; these figures already use the current inputs.
riskScore.why.raisedFrom: raised from {value} by its business context
riskScore.why.title: Why this score
